item.title: [No Priors] What Chess.com Teaches US About Superhuman Capabilities, with CEO Erik Allebest
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:24 COVID happened, Queen's Gambit happened, some news cycles happened, and we're like, oh, this might just be a flash in the pan, like treadmills and sourdough bread. But then in 2023, we had another crazy wave where all these kids started playing in schools because of short form content and the mittens bot and the cheating scandal. And we just spiked again. And then when we came down again, we were so much higher and we maintained this baseline.
